contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17, Lyons mint, issue of 330-331, RIC vol. 7 page 138 no. 241. Obverse description: Helmeted bust laureate left with spear over shoulder, mantled. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTINOPOLIS]. Reverse description: Victory with shield and spear on prow advancing left. In exergue: PLG. Diameter: 13.4mm, Weight: 1.28gms, die axis: 7
